newsitem.title: USA: Washington Gov. to sign property tax cut measure.
newsitem.headline: Washington Gov. to sign property tax cut measure.

text.p: Washington state Gov. Gary Locke on Thursday will sign legislation to extend a 4.7 percent reduction in state property taxes, his office said.
The bill would extend for one year a 4.7 percent reduction in state property taxes enacted during the last session of the state legislature.
Locke's office said the governor would sign House Bill 1417 at a press conference later Thursday.
The measure is expected to cost the state about $32 million in fiscal year 1997 and $26 million in fiscal year 1998, state officials estimated.
Last week, the governor vetoed legislation that would have extended the 4.7 percent reduction for seven years and vowed to develop a tax plan to benefit the state's homeowners.
Locke is expected to unveil his overall budget plan for the state in early March. The governor's budget plan would include his proposed tax changes, his office said.
